sentences.text: Hannah Price is the social worker from Harbridge children's services.
School contacted children's services because Millie told her teacher she didn't want to go home on Monday.
Millie Lambert is a child aged 9.
Stacey Lambert is Millie's mother.
Craig is Millie's stepfather and works on the bins.
Millie has a younger brother, Jayden, who is two years old.
Millie's father is in Scotland and she sees him only during summer holidays.
Stacey works mornings at Greggs.
Craig is described as being from a strict family.
The landlord is slow in fixing the damp in Millie's room.
Millie has a hamster named Biscuit who is asleep.
Millie enjoys art and is in the netball team in Year Four.
Jayden takes Millie's pens.
Millie told the teacher she didn't want to go home on Monday because of the bed.
Hannah Price said she will speak to Mrs Hollis at school tomorrow morning to ask the school nurse to refer Millie to the continence clinic.
Hannah Price said she will write to the landlord about the damp in Millie's room by Friday and visit again on Thursday the 26th.
When Millie wets the bed, Craig hits her with a belt on her legs.
Craig hits Millie with a belt on her legs every time she wets the bed, which happens about every week.
The last time Craig hit Millie was on Sunday morning, before Stacey woke up.
The hits leave red lines that go away.
Millie said no one else at home hurts her.
Stacey said she has never hit Millie and that she gives Millie cuddles.
Stacey said she has seen Craig hit Millie once or twice.
Stacey said Craig gives Millie a 'smack' with his belt on her legs, and it's not hard, and she believes it's not abuse.
Hannah Price stated that hitting a child with a belt is not acceptable and that she must act on it.
Hannah Price said she will speak to her manager and the police today, which is called a strategy discussion.
Hannah Price asked if Craig could stay away from the house until further notice.
Stacey said Craig's brother lives on Canal Street and could host him.
Stacey agreed to keep Craig away from the house until further communication.
Stacey said she will ring Craig now to move him to his brother's on Canal Street.
